sheet.div:
AI Chief Financial Officer Analysis
Select the historical date range to provide relevant data to the AI model.
The system will analyze open Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable, historical payments, and outstanding balances to generate a comprehensive financial dashboard.
You can also select the Odoo company for which you want to perform the analysis.
Additionally, you can provide any extra information, context, or specific instructions for the AI to consider during the analysis.

field.name: additional_info
field.placeholder: Extra context or instructions for the AI, e.g. - Our business is seasonal; Q4 revenue is always low. - Treat the Acme Corp receivable as secured; do not flag it as a risk. - Keep the executive summary conservative in tone.
